name: Instant Popup Builder – Boost Sales & Conversions with a Powerful Popup Maker for Opt-ins, Email Newsletters & Lead Generation
author: 7th Sky support

sections.installation:
From within WordPress

  1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. In the search bar, type Instant Popup Builder and press Enter.
  3. Locate the Instant Popup Builder plugin in the search results and click Install Now.
  4. Once the installation is complete, click Activate to enable the plugin.
  5. After activation, go to the new Instant Popups menu in your dashboard.
  6. Click Add New to create your first popup.

Manually

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress Plugins menu.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your popups using the plugin settings in the WordPress admin panel.
sections.faq:
Q: Is the plugin compatible with all WordPress themes?

A: Yes, it integrates seamlessly with all themes. However, as there are hundreds of themes, if you encounter any issues, please reach out to our Support Team, and we will assist you promptly.

Q: Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

A: Not at all, No coding skills are required to use the Instant Popup Builder plugin. You can create a popup in just a few clicks.

Q: Can I target specific audiences with my popups?

A: Yes, the plugin allows targeting by behavior, location, language, device, and more.

Q: What types of popups can I create?

A: You can create all types of popups, including exit-intent popups, video popups, image popups, and text popups. We continuously update our features, so if you notice a missing feature, please reach out to our Support Team, and we will add it to our feature queue for implementation.

Q: Will my popups be responsive?

A: Yes, all popups are fully responsive and mobile-friendly.

Q: How can I track popup performance?

A: Use the built-in analytics dashboard to monitor impressions, clicks, and conversions.

Q: Is support available?

A: Yes, our dedicated Support Team is available to assist you with any issues. Or you can ask any question on the Forum Page.

sections.description:
Effortlessly create elegant popups and instantly capture your visitors’ attention with the seamless Instant Popup Builder.

INSTANT POPUP BUILDER

Instant Popup Builder is the ultimate solution for any WordPress website. With a wide variety of popup types (Image, Text Only, HTML, and Vdideo Popups), triggers (on load, On Click, on hover, and Exit Intent), and display rules (Page, Posts, etc.), Instant Popup Builder empowers you to create engaging, high-converting, and fully customizable popups that meet your marketing needs.
This plugin allows you to collect emails, send newsletters, and display promotional or informative messages that align perfectly with your brand. Take advantage of advanced features like popup position settings, background customization, size adjustments, and action-based triggers to deliver popups tailored to your audience. Additionally, Instant Popup Builder provides built-in analytics and reporting tools to help you measure performance and optimize results. Whether you’re targeting users by language, location, or behavior, this plugin makes it easy to increase conversions, drive sales, and reach your marketing goals seamlessly.
Whether you’re looking to grow your email list, promote special offers, or increase engagement, Instant Popup Builder provides all the tools you need.

KEY FREE FEATURES:
– Unlimited Popups: Create as many popups as you like without any limitations.
– Display Rules: Easily set display rules for your popups in a few clicks. Choose to show them everywhere, on specific pages, or on specific posts.
– Trigger Popups by Events: Trigger popups based on user interactions, such as On Load, On Click, or On Hover.
– Closing: Decide how users can close the popup, such as by clicking outside the popup, pressing the Escape key, or even disabling the close option. You can also position the close button in different areas.
– Showing Limitations: Set how many times a popup is shown to a user and how often it appears. This helps reduce popup fatigue and prevents annoying users.
– Popup Position: Choose a position for your popup on the page, selecting from 9 different layout options.
– Popup Background: Customize the background of your popup to make it more appealing and engaging. Use images or colors and adjust the background opacity for a modern look.
– Popup Size: Define the size of your popup, particularly useful for text-only popups.
– Actions: Decide what happens when a user interacts with the popup. Redirect them to another page with a link, or set specific actions for clicks and closures.
– Analytics and Reporting: Get detailed insights into how your popups are performing with comprehensive analytics and reporting.

PREMIUM FEATURES:
– Video Popup: Easily create captivating Video Popup. The plugin supports YouTube, Vimeo, SoundCloud, and self-hosted MP4 videos, enabling you to showcase your content seamlessly.
– Exit Intent: Engage visitors before they leave your website with Exit Intent Popups. This feature employs intelligent detection technology to recognize when users are about to exit and presents a final offer to capture their attention and enhance conversions.
– Subscription Popup (mini): Grow your audience effortlessly with Subscription Popups. These popups strategically prompt visitors to subscribe to your newsletter or updates, helping you build a loyal customer base. With customizable designs and seamless integrations, you can boost engagement and increase conversions with ease.

More Features Coming Soon: We’re continuously improving and expanding the plugin to bring you even more powerful tools and functionalities. Stay tuned for upcoming features that will take your popup creation experience to the next level!

QUICK LINKS

– Subscribe to Instant Popup Builder’s YouTube Channel for tutorials, news and updates.

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries locally:

– Quill.js
– Description: A rich text editor used for toolbar options like bold, headings, italic, and font-family styles.
– License: MIT License
– Location: Bundled locally in the /admin/js/ folder.
– Data Usage: No data is sent to Quill.js servers; all processing is local.
– External Links: Quill.js Terms | Quill.js Privacy Policy

– Chart.js
– Description: A JavaScript library for creating responsive, customizable charts.
– License: MIT License
– Location: Bundled locally in the /admin/js/ folder.
– External Links: Chart.js Documentation | Chart.js License

– Highlight.js
– Description: A syntax highlighting library for code snippets.
– License: MIT License
– Location: Bundled locally in the /admin/js/ folder.
– External Links: Highlight.js Documentation | Highlight.js License

– JavaScript Dependencies
– Description: This plugin relies on the WordPress-bundled version of jQuery for certain functionalities.

Data Collection and Privacy

This plugin does not transmit any data to external servers. All bundled libraries operate locally, ensuring that data remains private to your WordPress site.

– Quill.js: Used for local text editing. No user data is transmitted externally.
– Chart.js and Highlight.js: Perform client-side operations only. No data is collected.
